cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve o'clock, yes. I've circled that twelve like you did. You kept my keys until half past; look what I missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Twelve is the bus number. I kept you waiting twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, route twelve. Twenty minutes with my dinner going cold. Here's the receipt; we can put it beside the timetable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we clear these papers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry, and I'll clear them. Otherwise we can work through exactly when my evening stopped being mine.

reason: Replace detachable certainty with a specific copied misunderstanding that changes how A delays, seeks apology or assent, transfers responsibility, or retrieves a lost plan.
